بُخَارٌ [Fume, vapour, steam, or exhalation;] what rises from water, like smoke; (S;) any fume (K, TA) that rises and diffuses itself (TA) from what is hot, (K, TA,) or from hot water; (TA;) anything that rises and diffuses itself from hot water or from damp earth: pl. أَبْخِرَةٌ and بُخَارَاتٌ. (Msb.) ―
-b2- Also The stench of a noiseless emission of wind from the anus. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also بَخَرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
